## Summary

What does this change do, and why? Keep it to 2-3 sentences.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that changes existing behaviour)
- [ ] Documentation only
- [ ] Refactor / internal cleanup (no user-visible change)

## AEO impact

Please tick anything this change affects:

- [ ] Schema output (JSON-LD)
- [ ] llms.txt generation
- [ ] AI crawler controls (robots.txt, headers)
- [ ] Citation Tracker
- [ ] Direct Answer Engine
- [ ] AI Generate (titles, meta, FAQ)
- [ ] Internal Link Builder
- [ ] Site Health checks
- [ ] Setup Wizard
- [ ] Dashboard UI
- [ ] Editor panel
- [ ] None (internal change only)

If schema output changes, please paste a Schema.org Validator screenshot or link below.

## Checklist

- [ ] Code follows the existing style (WordPress Coding Standards for PHP, existing eslint config for JS)
- [ ] No em dashes in user-facing strings or commit messages
- [ ] User-facing copy is plain English with customer benefit framing
- [ ] No new options have been added behind hidden flags. New settings appear in the Settings UI
- [ ] readme.txt and changelog.md updated if user-visible
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, or local paths committed
